procedure.title: Swap the graphics card in an MSI Trident 3

steps.check: Vented strip is free in hand and chassis edge is exposed
steps.coach: Pry gently around the edge to pop it free.
steps.failure: Forcing it snaps the plastic tabs
steps.instruction: Pry up the vented chassis panel to remove it

steps.check: Both screws are out and set aside
steps.coach: Keep these two together, they are the cover screws.
steps.failure: Cover will not slide if screws remain

steps.check: Side cover slides off and internals are exposed
steps.coach: Slide it straight to release the hooks.
steps.failure: Lifting without sliding bends the tabs
steps.instruction: Slide the whole computer cover off

steps.check: GPU fan and CPU blower are both visible and dusty but intact
steps.coach: Take a good look before you touch anything.
steps.failure: Missing damage or cable routing causes later errors
steps.instruction: Inspect the CPU cooler and GPU area

steps.check: All three retaining screws including the one under the motherboard are out
steps.coach: Don't miss the hidden third one.
steps.failure: GPU stays locked to the frame
steps.instruction: Unscrew the three GPU retaining screws

steps.check: Bracket screws are removed and kept separate as different screws
steps.coach: Remember these are different, keep them apart.
steps.failure: Mixing screws causes cross-threading on reassembly
Clip cannot move with screw in

steps.check: Clip is pulled clear of the GPU
steps.coach: Pull it straight out of the way.
steps.failure: GPU catches on the clip and damages the slot
steps.instruction: Pull the support clip out of the way

steps.check: Supporting bracket screws at the connector end are out
steps.coach: Get both bracket screws here as well.
steps.failure: Rear bracket holds the card in

steps.check: Wire is free from its clip and board
steps.coach: Ease the cable up with the tool.
steps.failure: Pulling chassis apart with cable attached tears the connector

steps.check: Back cover separates and can be lifted away
steps.coach: Nice - pull both sides apart gently.
steps.failure: Forcing it cracks the frame or cables
steps.instruction: Gently pull both sides apart to remove the metal cover

steps.check: Power plug is detached from the GPU
steps.failure: Pulling the card with power attached damages the plug

steps.check: GPU lifts evenly out of the PCIe slot with gold fingers visible
steps.coach: Apply even pressure and lift it straight out.
steps.failure: Rocking or twisting cracks the slot
steps.instruction: Pull the old graphics card from its slot

steps.check: Adapter cable is free from old card for reuse
steps.coach: Save this cable, you will need it later.
steps.failure: New card has no power without this cable
steps.instruction: Detach the power adapter cable from the old card

steps.check: New card is seated fully in the slot
steps.instruction: Place the replacement graphics card into the slot
